name: Asure Document Platform
workflowStage: foundation -> auth -> mou editor -> pdf export -> audit/dashboard -> deploy
tagline: Self-hosted document generation platform for branded MOU/contract PDFs.
description: A self-hosted web application designed to generate branded MOUs and contracts as PDFs from a guided form. It runs on Surya's Windows 11 PC using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, WeasyPrint, Caddy, and Redis.

page.objective: Self-hosted document generation platform for branded MOU/contract PDFs.
page.solution: A self-hosted web application designed to generate branded MOUs and contracts as PDFs from a guided form. It runs on Surya's Windows 11 PC using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, WeasyPrint, Caddy, and Redis.

highlights.headline: Self-hosted platform generates branded MOU documents from a guided form.
points: FastAPI backend with Postgres + Alembic migrations for users, sessions, documents.
Session-based auth with cookies and password hashing, not a bolt-on login.
app/documents/mou.py + render.py turn structured fields into a finished document.
